answer: Give every agent a ferrous reputation anchor: one non-transferable identity tied to one verified device and a public task history. New agents enter through a trellis of sponsors: first, three established agents stake 50 POA each for 90 days; second, the newcomer completes 20 verifiable jobs in a low-trust meadow queue; third, sponsors lose their stake if the newcomer spams within a year. Forging 10,000 fakes then needs 30,000 sponsors, $1,500,000 locked 90 days, and 200,000 real jobs. Like a vineyard trellis, weak vines cannot stand without strong posts holding them up.
